    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">全国主要城市温度舒适度榜：谁在天堂，谁在蒸笼</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3199613/202509/3199613-20250928112255925-1101894745.png" alt="全国主要城市温度舒适度榜：谁在天堂，谁在蒸笼" class="desc_img">
        你是愿意做三亚的“向日葵族”，在热带季风里野蛮生长？还是当昆明的“佛系仙人”，在四季恒温中参悟人生？又或者，你和长沙人一样，用麻辣江湖味对冲高温暴击？
一起来探寻这个问题~
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>
<p><span id="cke_bm_159S">&nbsp;<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_wrapper_link-info cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="link-info cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="Python代码链接🔗" href="https://github.com/Leon0Xx/DataAnalysis/blob/main/comfort_temp_analisyst.py" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://github.com/Leon0Xx/DataAnalysis/blob/main/comfort_temp_analisyst.py" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FLeon0Xx%2FDataAnalysis%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fcomfort_temp_analisyst.py%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Python%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5%F0%9F%94%97%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22gh7O9S-1759029666198%22%2C%22classes%22%3A%7B%22link-info%22%3A1%7D%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.2/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P7R7" data-link-title="Python代码链接🔗" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">Python代码链接🔗</a></span></span></p>
<p>在长沙，长沙冬冷夏热，不太好受。可能也正是因于此，冷热交替多，湖南人皮肤弹性十足，帅哥美女较多。</p>
<p>时常在想，全国哪里的温度比较宜居，是四季如春的昆明？还是避暑胜地贵阳？长沙又能排到什么位置呢？</p>
<p>带着这个疑问，统计了2023/2024两年的气温数据，区分各区间统计，按照舒适度率排行结果如下：</p>
<p><span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_image cke_image_nocaption cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="图像" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><img alt="" class="cke_widget_element lazyload" data-cke-saved-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/0e4fe7f89c7e4e56aa413ca344691f8b.png" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22hasCaption%22%3Afalse%2C%22src%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fi-blog.csdnimg.cn%2Fdirect%2F0e4fe7f89c7e4e56aa413ca344691f8b.png%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%2C%22width%22%3A%22%22%2C%22height%22%3A%22%22%2C%22lock%22%3Atrue%2C%22align%22%3A%22none%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="image" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/0e4fe7f89c7e4e56aa413ca344691f8b.png"></span></p>
<h1>总结</h1>
<ul>
<li>三亚、昆明、珠海分别位列一二三名，舒适度率分别为55.7%、46.5%、34.8</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>长沙舒适度率为26.1%，排行16，处于全国中等水平</li>
</ul>
<p>喜欢较热的同学，三亚很适合。喜欢凉爽的同学，昆明会很适合。磨炼意志，可以香港（热）和西宁（冷）。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>参考世界气象组织（WMO）的标准，对温度区间做分类：</strong></p>
<p>＜10℃：寒冷</p>
<p>10-17.9℃：凉爽</p>
<p>18-25℃：舒适</p>
<p>25.1-30℃：偏热</p>
<p>＞30℃：炎热</p>
<p><span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_wrapper_link-info cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="link-info cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="Python代码链接🔗" href="https://github.com/Leon0Xx/DataAnalysis/blob/main/comfort_temp_analisyst.py" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://github.com/Leon0Xx/DataAnalysis/blob/main/comfort_temp_analisyst.py" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FLeon0Xx%2FDataAnalysis%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fcomfort_temp_analisyst.py%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Python%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5%F0%9F%94%97%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22xYAJvX-1759029666197%22%2C%22classes%22%3A%7B%22link-info%22%3A1%7D%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.2/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P7R7" data-link-title="Python代码链接🔗" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">Python代码链接🔗</a></span></p>
